svg.title: Kyoto and Omi kettle records
svg.desc: A source-qualified comparison gives Ryubundo's documented 1958 endpoint, incomplete later Kibundo chronology, and the separate modern Unshikido revival. No proven bridge or direct succession is claimed.

g.text: Kyoto / Ōmi: records, not one succession
Evidence rule: proximity, a teacher claim, or a shared style does not prove a direct workshop succession.
